p4aef3aed22c5.name: defaultValue

peb3f22958c06.name: value

pcb21d9a5b320.name: children

p47d173269655.name: collapseIcon
p47d173269655.description: Icon source shown while this item is expanded.

p1321536caa84.name: expandIcon
p1321536caa84.description: Icon source shown while this item is collapsed.

p54c4e698bdef.name: singleLine
p54c4e698bdef.description: Forces the trigger content slot to one line with ellipsis when it exceeds the available width.

pd9f36906c19f.name: elevated
pd9f36906c19f.description: Switches the AppBar from its default flat surface to the themed raised surface. Sticky or scroll state never changes elevation automatically.

pe87216a3be40.name: leading
pe87216a3be40.description: Content rendered in the leading action region.

pdbc1d678b9ce.name: mode
pdbc1d678b9ce.description: Chooses full-width or floating geometry. Full removes outer margin and radius; floating keeps themed margin and radius.

p86a7a263fb47.name: size
p86a7a263fb47.description: Selects the themed AppBar height, slot margins, gap, and default title typography role.

pc2597801f5e2.name: sticky
pc2597801f5e2.description: Uses native position: sticky with top: 0 while preserving the same visual state and elevation.

p7e53ec96ad87.name: title
p7e53ec96ad87.description: Required direct Weave Text element rendered in the title region. An explicit Text typo overrides the size default.

pcaa1df26b307.name: titleAlign
pcaa1df26b307.description: Aligns the title within the real middle grid region; it does not force absolute centering against the viewport.

pe7617e9a3d45.name: trailing
pe7617e9a3d45.description: Content rendered in the trailing action region.

p6ba7efb96463.name: fallback
p6ba7efb96463.description: Explicit fallback content shown when no usable image is available. It takes precedence over initials generated from name.

pb4dc146c2330.name: name
pb4dc146c2330.description: Entity name used to generate initials when no image or explicit fallback is available; it does not replace accessible labeling in viewProps.

p9736f37358d5.name: src
p9736f37358d5.description: Optional image source. A successfully loaded image wins over fallback content; load failure automatically falls back.

p04c56c9fc9c1.name: children
p04c56c9fc9c1.description: Target content that the Badge attaches to. The badge is positioned from the target’s live visual bounds without taking normal layout space.

p236cd3a97853.name: dot
p236cd3a97853.description: Switches to the dot-only visual mode. When true, text is not allowed and the dot is treated as decorative.

p9389a2db0cff.name: placement
p9389a2db0cff.description: Chooses one of eight edge positions around the target and also determines the direction of enter and exit motion.

p9a2be629702f.name: text
p9a2be629702f.description: Visible badge content in normal mode. Required unless dot is true and omitted entirely in dot mode.

p5da11e0d22e6.name: visible
p5da11e0d22e6.description: Shows or hides only the badge indicator while keeping the wrapped children mounted and visible.

pd075476d4a22.name: children
pd075476d4a22.description: Custom button content. When children is used, text, icon, and iconPosition are not allowed.

p4f78ff5fa2ad.name: disabled
p4f78ff5fa2ad.description: Disables the native button, prevents pointer and keyboard activation, and applies the shared disabled state. It takes precedence over pressed styling.

p4d52554ea6b7.name: icon
p4d52554ea6b7.description: Optional icon source for the semantic content mode. With no text it creates an icon-only button; it cannot be combined with children.

pc8074bfbe578.name: iconPosition
pc8074bfbe578.description: Places the semantic-mode icon before or after text. It has no effect in custom children mode.

p52c70993bea6.name: lg
p52c70993bea6.description: Overrides supported props at the lg viewport breakpoint.

p8a03cf059f20.name: md
p8a03cf059f20.description: Overrides supported props at the md viewport breakpoint.

pd676fd18b82f.name: pressed
pd676fd18b82f.description: Controlled persistent toggle-button state. When provided, Button exposes aria-pressed; when omitted, Button remains a normal push button.

pad9cb276b533.name: size
pad9cb276b533.description: Selects the themed control size, including minimum height, padding, content gap, and typography role.

p63cdd2355787.name: sm
p63cdd2355787.description: Overrides supported props at the sm viewport breakpoint.

p06fd5289985c.name: text
p06fd5289985c.description: Visible semantic button label. It can be paired with icon, and cannot be combined with custom children.

p1bd82e09cde6.name: type
p1bd82e09cde6.description: Sets the native button type. The default is button; use submit or reset only when native form behavior is intended.

p1e720744749d.name: variant
p1e720744749d.description: Selects the themed visual variant: primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost, or danger.

p81fbbc6a767d.name: xl
p81fbbc6a767d.description: Overrides supported props at the xl viewport breakpoint.

pd5754de8702d.name: children
pd5754de8702d.description: Content rendered inside the Card surface.

p1a2a64d37ea8.name: clickable
p1a2a64d37ea8.description: Enables Card activation and keyboard activation. It is independent from selectable and uses viewProps.onClick for the activation handler.

pda229465b69f.name: defaultSelected
pda229465b69f.description: Initial selected state for an uncontrolled selectable Card. It is available only when selectable is true.

p28dcccaffe24.name: onSelectedChange
p28dcccaffe24.description: Called when Card activation requests a selection toggle. Calling preventDefault in viewProps.onClick cancels that default toggle.

p061f269c03fa.name: selectable
p061f269c03fa.description: Enables boolean selection and aria-pressed semantics. Only selectable Cards may use selected, defaultSelected, and onSelectedChange.

pa155751acb60.name: selected
pa155751acb60.description: Controlled selected state for a selectable Card. When provided, the parent owns the current selection value.

p5f2d12d9ecb6.name: checked
p5f2d12d9ecb6.description: Controlled checked state for the native checkbox input.

p32a198b8a298.name: defaultChecked
p32a198b8a298.description: Initial checked state for an uncontrolled Checkbox.

pcb86e04ae9e9.name: disabled
pcb86e04ae9e9.description: Disables the native checkbox input and its bound label interaction.

pb12ce1e17e2a.name: group

p5a49c7ba1382.name: indeterminate
p5a49c7ba1382.description: Sets the native indeterminate property and exposes mixed accessibility state. It does not replace the underlying boolean checked value.

p70b4a0081a5d.name: label
p70b4a0081a5d.description: Visible native-bound label content. Clicking the label toggles this checkbox and contributes to its accessible name.

p31d64e616ed1.name: onChange
p31d64e616ed1.description: Called with the native boolean checked state when this checkbox changes.

p9da1c2666046.name: size
p9da1c2666046.description: Selects the themed control and surrounding state-layer geometry size.

pe3eac4000286.name: value
pe3eac4000286.description: Native checkbox value submitted when this option is checked.

p03ee0c84b6f1.description: Source code string rendered inside the highlighted code block.

pecd54eba2c88.name: direction

pdc0f440a0f6e.name: defaultOpen

p0a976319e1c5.name: disabled

p8195ac9c7bbb.name: emptyContent
p8195ac9c7bbb.description: Content shown in the listbox when filtering leaves no visible options.

p65520923cdaa.name: inputValue
p65520923cdaa.description: Controlled editable input text. Typing changes this state without changing the committed value.

p091d6d06f00f.name: listboxViewProps
p091d6d06f00f.description: Applies View customization to the popup listbox without replacing its listbox semantics or positioning.

pa67c18014a76.name: name
pa67c18014a76.description: Optional native form field name used to submit the committed selected value.

p95eaf2c9ee6f.name: offset
p95eaf2c9ee6f.description: Distance between the input anchor and popup along the placement axis.

pe3f2ee67b9fa.name: onOpenChange

p5f58317d245a.name: onValueChange
p5f58317d245a.description: Called when an option is committed or the control is cleared. Typing alone does not call it.

p0c304eb4ed2d.name: overlapTrigger
p0c304eb4ed2d.description: Allows the popup to overlap the input anchor instead of being positioned outside its edge.

p14381aa047fc.name: placeholder
p14381aa047fc.description: Placeholder text shown in the editable input when it is empty.

p74392ba41fa5.name: placement
p74392ba41fa5.description: Preferred anchored-overlay placement for the listbox popup.

p7604b19ef281.name: value

pb5bd752827d7.name: viewportPadding
pb5bd752827d7.description: Minimum collision padding kept between the popup and viewport edges.

p29d285db0dd2.name: disabled
p29d285db0dd2.description: Disables this option and excludes it from selection, keyboard navigation, and filtering results that can be committed.

p4aeb7d55876b.name: icon
p4aeb7d55876b.description: Optional icon shown with the option and with the committed selection.

pc713a5ab46bd.name: secondaryText
pc713a5ab46bd.description: Supplementary text shown in the popup option.

p1eb30c257280.name: textValue
p1eb30c257280.description: Stable plain-text representation used for filtering and input synchronization when text is not directly string-like.

pcf37c34e617b.name: value

pc0c606570c11.name: defaultSelected
pc0c606570c11.description: Initial atomic Table cell selection for an uncontrolled selectable DataGrid.

p5d6f45d4dfda.name: defaultSort
p5d6f45d4dfda.description: Initial sort state for uncontrolled sorting.

p10743731a970.name: dense
p10743731a970.description: Forwards the dense padding preset to the underlying Table.

p21fc87128755.name: onColumnWidthsChange
p21fc87128755.description: Called continuously while a resizable column changes, with the complete current width map.

p19482649c34a.name: onSelect
p19482649c34a.description: Called with the complete atomic Table cell selection after selection changes.

p80bc00812cfd.name: onSortChange
p80bc00812cfd.description: Called when sortable-header interaction requests a new sort column/direction.

p258fc527088f.name: selected
p258fc527088f.description: Controlled atomic Table cell selection for the DataGrid.

p4c0d2d4c8a02.name: sort

p3de8bc1d2b0d.description: Forwards native sticky-header behavior to the underlying Table.

p0e219698bb16.name: verticalBorders

pc70c374b423f.description: Enables row windowing while preserving native table structure and selection knowledge for the complete row set.

p9228bbb6f974.description: Non-modal only. Forwards to Popover and controls whether opening moves focus into the dialog content.

p44d806fc42ea.name: closeOnEscape
p44d806fc42ea.description: Modal only. Allows the native dialog cancel event from Escape to request closing. The default is true.

pe0266ad0f98a.name: defaultOpen
pe0266ad0f98a.description: Initial open state when Dialog is uncontrolled.

pd8869f6749e1.name: initialFocus
pd8869f6749e1.description: Modal only. Focus target used immediately after showModal(); when omitted, native dialog focusing behavior is preserved.

pc3d8fdeda9ba.description: Selects the implementation branch: false or omitted reuses Popover; true uses a native dialog opened with showModal().

pef843c46bd1c.name: offset
pef843c46bd1c.description: Non-modal only. Forwards the anchor-to-surface distance to Popover.

pf469c5617203.name: onOpenChange
pf469c5617203.description: Called when Dialog interaction or native dialog behavior requests an open-state change.

p30dc90293c6c.name: placement
p30dc90293c6c.description: Non-modal only. Forwards the preferred anchored placement to Popover, including its collision handling.

p4890556f4f76.name: restoreFocus
p4890556f4f76.description: Controls whether focus returns to the previously focused element after closing. It defaults to true.

p7e5805432b5e.name: trigger
p7e5805432b5e.description: Non-modal only. Required trigger element used by Popover as both the anchor and open/close control.

p2deb66967e15.name: viewportPadding
p2deb66967e15.description: Non-modal only. Forwards the minimum collision padding between the Popover surface and viewport edges.

pd5ed6a6e3401.name: direction
pd5ed6a6e3401.description: Chooses a horizontal or vertical separator and sets the matching separator orientation semantics.

p35f6a5634f74.name: gap
p35f6a5634f74.description: Adds whitespace on both sides of the line: top/bottom for horizontal dividers and left/right for vertical dividers. A value of 0 adds no layout space.

pf4e01b09b4e8.name: size

p9afb5e104213.name: breakpoint

pcda885cd05bf.name: children

pd4e129ae2bd9.name: closeOnBackdrop

p6e31838c6416.name: closeOnEscape

p363ac7105e2f.name: closeThreshold

p25f416574ac2.name: collapseThreshold

p3e282742a9e8.name: defaultOpen
p3e282742a9e8.description: Initial open state when Drawer is uncontrolled.

p9fe819f3bcb9.name: defaultSize

pa95d54618835.name: drawerViewProps
pa95d54618835.description: Configures the Drawer surface itself, including explicit surface styling and its AutoScrollbar settings.

pd04f3db64b1e.name: expandThreshold

p5444c50ce6bf.name: minSize

p979bcc22fe75.name: onOpenChange

p246dd35487d3.name: onSizeChange

p5ffbd99d31b1.name: resizable

p330e3e537f48.name: restoreFocus
p330e3e537f48.description: Modal only. Controls whether closing restores the previously focused element. The default is true.

p533e8c02f00e.name: side
p533e8c02f00e.description: Chooses the viewport edge for the Drawer and therefore whether its size controls width or height. The default is right.

p2f4dcdcfa193.name: size
p2f4dcdcfa193.description: Controlled Drawer size along its side axis. It is mutually exclusive with defaultSize.

pbcbade84b0f2.name: layout
pbcbade84b0f2.description: Fixed to flex by Flex and cannot be changed.

pf1b1f6c80ce7.name: children
pf1b1f6c80ce7.description: Form controls, fields, and actions rendered inside the native form element.

pc7e2c2f00a81.name: onReset

p7ffba55a0235.name: label
p7ffba55a0235.description: Convenience field label linked to participating controls through aria-labelledby. Do not also provide an explicit FormLabel.

p1cf8742c0810.name: required

pc9662b29f5bb.name: children

p68ad870b794f.name: children
p68ad870b794f.description: Legend content rendered by a real legend element for a FormFieldset.

peb1763b25b0c.name: layout
peb1763b25b0c.description: Fixed to grid by Grid and cannot be changed.
